Cap.1: The Adaptive
Organism
One Living, Evolving
Mind
Mycelial Mind v2.0.0
(MC 1.21.1, NeoForge
21.1.176, Java 21)
replaces static
difficulty with a
persistent-memory
hive
(`HiveMindSavedData`).
Every damage stimulus
(`StimulusType`) and

tactical habit
(`PlayerHabit`)
recalibrates traits
(`AdaptationTrait`),
synergies, raids, and
subterranean nodes.

Golden Rule: Vary
Your Arsenal
Repeating one damage
type fills its threshold
(70.0 at Tier 1 and
effective 200.0 at Tier
2), hardening the
swarm against that
tactic.
Rotate melee,
projectiles, fire,
blasts, and magic;
purge Nodes and
craft

countermeasures at
the Synaptic Bench to
bleed Hive memory.

ench`.

Cap.3: Immune Memory
& Router
Synaptic Memory
Routing (1/2)
• 40/60 Split
(`SynapticMemoryRoute
r`): if a hostile Node
lies within 48m
(`BUFFER_NODE_RANGE`
), only 40% enters
global memory directly
while 60% stays in the
node's volatile buffer.

Synaptic Memory
Routing (2/2)
• Consolidation vs
Purge: after 600 ticks
(30s) the buffer
commits globally.
Shattering the Node
earlier voids
uncommitted data,
drops
`volatile_engram`, and
bleeds
`nodeDestructionStimul
usBleed` (18.0).
